subject: Diesel up 6.2 cents as freight fraud spreads
headline: Diesel climbs to $3.842 while double brokering spreads
dek: Fuel is up 14.1 cents in four weeks, fraud reports pile up, and FMCSA clarified the short-haul rule.
lede: The U.S. diesel average hit $3.842 a gallon for the week of October 12, up 6.2 cents in a week. At the same time, fraud and theft reports are climbing.

sections.heading: Fraud keeps spreading
sections.body: A double brokering scheme hit 40 Midwest loads, and cargo theft rose 12% in the third quarter.

sections.heading: Short-haul rule clarified
sections.body: FMCSA clarified the 150 air-mile short-haul exception in its hours of service rules.

sections.heading: Spot rates steady
sections.body: Spot van rates are holding near $2.05 a mile, with tender rejections at 5.8%.

seo_description: Diesel at $3.842, freight fraud rising, and the FMCSA short-haul clarification: the NSNN freight brief for October 16.
